family: The single total language L of proof.md section 1, decided at every length N by one fixed evaluator A. If N<16 output 0. Else k is the largest integer with 4^k<=N, t=2^k, m0=floor((N-t)/(t+1)), m=m0 if m0 is odd and m=m0-1 otherwise, l=N-t-m-t*m; if m<1 output 0. Bits 1..t define R(W)=W^t+sum_{v<t} x_{v+1}W^v and bits t+1..t+m define Q(Z)=Z^m+sum_{u<m} x_{t+u+1}Z^u over F_2; if R or Q fails the exact irreducibility test of proof.md (X^(2^d)=X mod P, and gcd(P,X^(2^d')-X)=1 for every divisor d' of d=deg P with d'<d) output 0. Otherwise the next t*m bits c_{u,v} (bit number t+m+v*m+u+1) give z=sum c_{u,v}Z^uW^v in the field E=(F_2[Z]/(Q))[W]/(R) with 2^(tm) elements, the last l bits are ignored, and the output is 1 iff z^e=1 for e=sum_{j=0}^{t-1} 2^(m*j). All t+m+l prefix and leftover bits are counted in N; R and Q are input, not advice.
theorem: For the single fixed total language L defined in proof.md Section 1, its evaluator A runs in polynomial time on every input, and L is in NP with witness bound zero and the verifier accepting exactly empty witnesses with A(x)=1. In the full Li-Yang B2 model at entire input length N, there is an integer N_0>=256 such that every integer N>=N_0 satisfies C_B2(L_N)>=(315323783211583831670874691/65323783211583831670874691)N. The eventual lower bound has identically zero subtracted remainder. Proof.md Section 5 derives it from the separately proved all-length bound C_B2(L_N)>=(630647566423167663341749381/130647566423167663341749381)N-R_0(N), where R_0(N)/N tends to zero, by the strictly positive difference between these two coefficients. The intermediate bound uses the structural cutwidth improvement gamma_0=(130647566423167663341749381/1000000000000000000000000000) proved in cutwidth.md Theorem 2, not a claim that the finite path sum itself is below gamma_0. This also proves the declared finite projection with coefficient 315323783211583831670874691/65323783211583831670874691 and exponent 1. No explicit threshold N_0 is claimed. Complete supporting proofs are in proof.md, circuit.md, cutwidth.md, krs.md and certificate.md, with the fresh finite path and local-event computation certify.py.
